All students are advised of this situation. Students who want to secure provisional admission to Baba Hira Das Ayurvedic Medical College and Hospital, Badal, Muktsar are required to deposit the fee with the University by 16th December 2024. This is in compliance of order dated passed by the Hon'ble High Court in the above mention case. Click here to fee in shape of Demand Draft in favour of Registrar Guru Ravidas Ayurved University Hoshiarpur.
